Pakistan coach Hesson says team must 'catch up' with India in T20 cricket

Pakistan cricket coach Mike Hesson stated that his team must 'catch up' with India in T20 cricket. Hesson, who took charge in May last year, noted that Pakistan has lost to India three times in the Asia Cup and once in the Twenty20 World Cup since then. He indicated Pakistan's intention to put India 'under pressure' in the Asian Games, referencing past strategies.
